reason: My Booking score is my income, and I'm not letting a brand-new one-person company's robot talk to my guests. My laminated sheet has never given a wrong answer, and when guests write to me I answer them myself.
objection: One wrong answer about check-in or parking at midnight and a German guest gives me a 7 for communication. Then I've lost far more than €120. A refund doesn't fix a bad review, and if this one man gets sick or closes in July, who answers?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it running for a whole season with hosts I know on this coast, and their review scores going the same or up, not down.
